thread.title: Dow Movers: INTC, DWDP

author: BNK Invest
title: Dow Movers: INTC, DWDP
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Friday, shares of DowDuPont ( DWDP ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 3.1%. Year to date, DowDuPont registers a 8.6% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is Intel Corp ( INTC ), trading down 7.4%. Intel Corp is lower by about 1.8% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Merck & Co ( MRK ), trading down 0.8%, and Apple ( AAPL ), trading up 2.3% on the day.
